policy: User-authorized 2026-10-13: sliding lid box, snap-fit electronics case, surface shoehorn; then surface iron and piston assembly. Dependency closure and independent workflow verification required. Split broad requirements into finishable children before pulling; preserve source qualification blockers. Prior accepted milestones remain done.

checkpoints.title: Parametric sliding-lid box
checkpoints.acceptance: Full creation movie and step ledger, readable parameter/selection states, editable assembled model, meaningful resize maintaining clearance and joint limits, history/reopen and separately checked millimeter STL for both printable parts. Final-looking geometry alone does not pass.
checkpoints.remaining: None for the bounded accepted workflow; source reflection, API/native distinctions and focused thumb replay are recorded in the receipt.

checkpoints.title: Snap-fit electronics enclosure
checkpoints.acceptance: Full source-stage ledger/movie, editable model with preserved reference geometry, two valid closed case halves with verified clearances/snaps/ports/lip, update/history/reopen and separately checked printable exports. Qualification and every feature dependency must close before this gate.
checkpoints.remaining: Mounting TUT-020, port/card TUT-021 and adapted split/snap TUT-022 API checkpoints are independently accepted with from-blank recordings. TUT-023 alignment rim remains; full TUT-016 also retains DOC-031 native naming and DOC-032 face-linked section support. The nominal board has a known connector collision; no whole-board or physical-fit certification.

checkpoints.title: Surface shoehorn
checkpoints.acceptance: Full creation movie, endpoint and intermediate surface captures, editable file, meaningful path/thickness edit retaining through hole, undo/reopen and strict mesh. Source freedom and native/API differences explicit.
checkpoints.remaining: Guided source prefix and signed Thicken are accepted. GEO-019 must qualify exact wide-end R12 grouped corner geometry on the inferred 16 mm-bend fixture before GEO-018 can retain generated faces/endpoints and the later R1.5 perimeter round. PRT-010 still qualifies component printing with the retained hidden sheet; ASM-012 retains native Browser move. Complete TUT-017 creation, edit/history/reopen, movie and strict export remain pending.

checkpoints.title: Surface iron
checkpoints.acceptance: Creation movie including declared sketch setup, editable surfaces/final solid, silhouette and handle comparisons against public images, upstream edits/history/reopen and checked solid/mesh outputs. Prepared-sketch adaptation remains labeled.
checkpoints.remaining: RES-018 qualifies the public source ledger and independently authored prepared-sketch topology; no source sketch dimensions or from-blank construction are documented. Next source-sized ingredients are ordered guide-rail/bridge surface Loft SRF-012, retained surface Trim SRF-013 and Two Sides open-curve surface Extrude SRF-014, followed by Boundary Fill SRF-011, local canvas DOC-024, Remove HIS-007 and full TUT-018. Broad SRF-001/002/005 remain Todo for their larger scope.
